# Milkyverse

> An independent creative and development studio. Distinctive websites, digital products and imagined worlds, made in India.

Milkyverse is an independent studio based in India that builds for clients anywhere. It designs and builds websites, online stores, web and mobile apps, and 3D/CGI imagery.

Contact: connect@milkyverse.co.in (replies within one working day)

## Services

- [Websites](https://milkyverse.co.in/services/websites/): Websites designed and built in code, phone first, with copy, search setup and handover.
- [Online stores](https://milkyverse.co.in/services/stores/): Shopify and D2C store design and build, product pages, checkout and tracking.
- [Apps and products](https://milkyverse.co.in/services/apps/): Web apps and iOS and Android apps, designed, built and released.
- [3D and CGI](https://milkyverse.co.in/services/3d/): 3D product visualisation and CGI.
- [All services](https://milkyverse.co.in/services/)

## Work

- [Web & Apps](https://milkyverse.co.in/web/): Selected websites, stores and digital products.
- [3D & CGI](https://milkyverse.co.in/3d/): Selected 3D and CGI projects.
- [Oddzy](https://milkyverse.co.in/work/oddzy/): Sports intelligence, designed for the everyday fan.
- [OUTLWD](https://milkyverse.co.in/work/outlwd/): An independent jewellery brand with an unmistakable edge.
- [Flowing Tiger MMA](https://milkyverse.co.in/work/flowing-tiger/): An expressive website for a martial arts community.
- [Signature Xperience](https://milkyverse.co.in/work/signature-xperience/): A cinematic home for live-event effects.
- [Oddzy for iPhone](https://milkyverse.co.in/work/oddzy-app/): The Oddzy model as a native iPhone app.
